verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents the official Windows App SDK and WinUI 3, with a quickstart, guidance for adding it to existing projects, and a UWP migration path. Its official language bindings cover C#/.NET 8+, C++ (Win32, C++/WinRT) and Rust (windows-rs), and Windows AI APIs plus the AI Foundry toolkit are listed for AI-oriented development. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience, and depth on the AI APIs/AI Foundry SDK surface beyond doc titles.
